changelog:
- WireGuard Tunnel Engine: Integrated userspace WireGuard VPN tunnel with Android VpnService permission flow.
- Enhanced Privacy Gateway: Fail-closed proxy architecture preventing direct network leaks and in-browser exit-IP verification.
- Video PiP Quick Button: Dedicated minimize control for active playing videos.
- Reliable Background Audio: Pre-pause hooks and screen-lock handlers for uninterrupted media playback.
- Fokk AI Summary & Fact-Check: Article provenance extraction and multi-source independent evidence audit.
